# YVA Law Staffing

> Bilingual (English and Spanish) virtual legal staff for U.S. law firms: legal intake specialists, legal assistants, demand writers and case managers, billed hourly from $8.50/hr with no long-term contract. Staff are vetted and trained by YVA, work in U.S. time zones, and are based in the Dominican Republic and Latin America.

## Key facts

- Rates (per hour): Legal Intake $8.50 · Legal Assistants $9.50 · Demand Writing $10 · Case Managers $12. Full time = 160 hours a month (e.g. Legal Intake $1,360/month).
- Every assistant is fully bilingual in English and Spanish.
- Onboarding: ready within 72 business hours after the consultation call and match; YVA handles briefing and setup.
- Service agreement with no long-term lock-in; a replacement at no extra cost if the fit is not right.
- Works inside the firm's own tools (Clio, MyCase, HubSpot, Salesforce, Slack, Google Workspace and others); assistants work under attorney supervision and do not give legal advice.
- Founded: 2023
- Law firms served: 50+
- Assistants placed: 100+
- Contact: contact@yvastaffing.agency · Mon – Fri · 9am – 6pm EST · book a free call at https://yvastaffing.agency/?contact=1

## Services

- [Bilingual Virtual Legal Intake Specialists](https://yvastaffing.agency/virtual-legal-intake/): Bilingual virtual legal intake specialists for U.S. law firms: calls, client screening, CRM entry and consult booking in English and Spanish, from $8.50/hr.
- [Bilingual Virtual Legal Assistants for Law Firms](https://yvastaffing.agency/virtual-legal-assistants/): Hire a bilingual virtual legal assistant for your law firm: calendars, client emails, case files, deadlines and drafting, vetted and trained, from $9.50/hr.
- [Demand Writing Services for Personal Injury Firms](https://yvastaffing.agency/demand-writing-services/): Outsourced demand letter writing for personal injury firms: medical record review, damages, demand letters and settlement packages, from $10/hr.
- [Bilingual Virtual Case Managers for Law Firms](https://yvastaffing.agency/virtual-case-managers/): Bilingual virtual case managers for law firms and PI case management: client and provider coordination, treatment follow-up and deadlines, from $12/hr.
